topics.title: Patient Master Index & Demographic Registration
topics.objective: Establish unified medical record numbers (MRN) and manage patient identity without duplicate records.
topics.example: PatientRecord: { MRN: 'HOSP-2026-9921', demographics: { name, dob, blood_group } }
topics.exercise: Design an automated patient deduplication algorithm using probabilistic matching on national ID and DOB.

topics.title: Real-Time Inpatient Bed Allocation & Ward Telemetry
topics.objective: Track bed occupancy across ICU, general, and emergency wards with automated cleaning and turnover workflows.
topics.exercise: Create a real-time bed management state machine handling admission, transfer, discharge, and sanitization cycles.

topics.title: Outpatient (OPD) Clinic Scheduling & Queue Optimization
topics.objective: Schedule clinical consultations while dynamically adjusting queues based on urgent triage priorities.
topics.example: AppointmentQueue: PriorityQueue ordered by triage severity and arrival timestamp.
topics.exercise: Implement a clinic queue dispatch system that prioritizes emergency walk-ins ahead of routine checkups.

topics.title: Inpatient Pharmacy Dispensing & Charge Capture
topics.objective: Verify computerized physician order entry (CPOE) medications against real-time billing ledgers.
topics.exercise: Build a transaction pipeline ensuring medication charges are posted to the patient ledger upon barcode dispensation.

topics.title: HIPAA Privacy, Audit Logs & Medical Access Governance
topics.objective: Restrict Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) access and record immutable audit logs.
topics.exercise: Write an audit logging interceptor capturing every read operation on patient medical charts.
